svg.title: Green Lantern power battery - performance timeline
svg.text: The performance — timeline of one pour
hold-to-pour: the pour and the brightening light happen during the oath; seconds are approximate (pour time = pourMs)
Hold the twist through the oath:
the pump pours and the light
the glass back, lift it out:
On the first line, twist 45° and
hold: the cam clicks the switch
you are still holding; the light
Let go early and the pump stops where it is; the light swells ~10 % and goes dark (no resume until the ring is removed and re-inserted). Pulling the ring out stops the pump within 60 ms.
